entities.name: Miri
entities.description: An Orzhov tithe taker and secret flesh mage who is torn between her family's pressure to skim, her desire to join Selesnya and her love for her father; she keeps her ledger and journal.

entities.name: Miri's Father
entities.description: An Orzhov pontiff in debt after bad investments who pushes Miri to skim tithes and chase get-rich-quick schemes, and who loves her.

entities.name: Miri's Mother
entities.description: Miri's mother, status-conscious but secretly understanding, who gives Miri a Selesnyan crown to present as her prize.

entities.name: Fleshmage Jarek
entities.description: A fleshmage who employs Miri to make thrulls and harvests spirits from borrowers.

entities.name: Danika
entities.description: A former Azorius arrester and Selesnyan initiate who befriends Miri and covers for her growth spell.

entities.name: Caz
entities.description: An unguilded Selesnyan initiate in Miri's pod who teaches her the seed spark invocation.

entities.name: Vasil
entities.description: An unguilded Selesnyan initiate in Miri's pod who coaches her on the Chant of Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: The Spy
entities.description: A woman in Selesnyan robes pleading before Jarek claiming knowledge of a vulnerability at Vitu-Ghazi, believed to be a Dimir spy.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The Orzhov ghost council whose collapse wiped out the family's ancestral wealth.

entities.name: Oligarchs
entities.description: The Orzhov elite who receive tithes and whose approval the family seeks.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of wealth, tithes and debt, which Miri serves as a tithe taker.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of harmony and nature that Miri secretly joins as an initiate.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild whose magelord once attacked Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The guild of spies, suspected of employing the spy in the reckoning room.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnyan world tree whose secret structural weaknesses Miri sees through the artifact.

entities.name: Initiates' Compound
entities.description: The Selesnyan compound where Miri's orientation takes place.

entities.name: Crown of Convergence
entities.description: A delicate golden crown radiating white light that Miri's mother gives her to present as a prize from Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Selesnyan Artifact
entities.description: A Selesnyan artifact that appears in Miri's robe pocket and reveals Vitu-Ghazi's hidden weaknesses.

entities.name: Tithing Hike
entities.description: Orzhova's raised tithes to thirty percent, which sparks rioting that ends with a settlement at eighteen percent.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the story is set.

events.summary: Miri's first refusal as a tithe taker: a citizen refuses the thirty-percent tithe, curses the Obzedat and attacks her, and she subdues him.
events.quote: I dealt him a forearm to the temple and then used my staff to sweep his feet from underneath him.

events.summary: Miri gives her father the money she skimmed from tithes, and it is revealed the family fortune was lost with the Ghost Council.
events.quote: He'd returned home with the truth: there was no family fortune.

events.summary: Miri reveals she secretly works for a fleshmage making thrulls and gives half her pay to help citizens short on tithes.
events.quote: So I got a second job assisting a fleshmage.

events.summary: Miri's father comes home with a thrull-replaced leg after a failed scheme involving an Izzet machine and wurms, and curses Selesnya.
Miri overhears a woman begging Jarek for her life with information on a Vitu-Ghazi vulnerability, and Jarek flays her and binds her spirit to a tome.
events.quote: He flayed the borrower from head to toe

events.summary: Miri steals the dead spy's Selesnyan robes.
events.quote: I shoved the robes into my satchel.

events.summary: Miri's father catches her in the Selesnyan robes, and she lies that she is going undercover to exploit the vulnerability at Vitu-Ghazi.
events.quote: I'm going undercover to see if I can find it

events.summary: Miri joins the Selesnyan initiates and befriends Danika, Caz and Vasil.
events.quote: Danika, Caz, and Vasil are in my assigned developmental pod.

events.summary: Miri spends a day bartering for new robes and attends a long Collective Blessing, where Danika lends her a shawl.
events.quote: Danika saw my frustration and leant me a shawl

events.summary: Miri's growth spell fails, and Danika swaps pots with her and takes the elder's punishment.
events.quote: at the last possible second, she switched her pot with mine.

events.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi a mysterious artifact appears in Miri's pocket and reveals that the world tree is fragile and could be toppled.
events.quote: One well-targeted attack could bring the whole structure down, this time for good.

events.summary: Miri's mother secretly gives her the Crown of Convergence to give her father in place of the vulnerability, and Miri gives it to him.
events.quote: The Crown of Convergence? Miri, this is worth thousands!

events.summary: Miri returns to work after the tithing revolt ends at eighteen percent and presents her father with a secret enchanted money tree.

relations.note: Father and daughter; he pushes her to skim.
relations.quote: there's no fortune in this world that could tip the scales against the love I have for you.

relations.note: She secretly assists him making thrulls.
relations.quote: So I got a second job assisting a fleshmage.
It's my third full week as a certified tithe taker

relations.note: Danika helps and covers for Miri.
relations.quote: if we couldn't go together, at least I'd be able to go alone.

relations.note: He flays her and harvests her spirit.
relations.quote: He flayed the borrower from head to toe, and as soon as Jarek made the final cut, the spirit drifted free toward the ceiling.
